vars.ansible_become_password: {{ (s.become_1 | b64decode) if s.become_1 is defined else omit }}

ansible.builtin.shell.cmd:
for r in {{ od.lock_repos | map('quote') | join(' ') }}; do
  f="$r/.opsdeck-deploy.lock"
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "OD-PF lock repo=$r held=1 raw_b64=$(base64 < "$f" | tr -d '\n')"; else echo "OD-PF lock repo=$r held=0 raw_b64="; fi
done

miss=""
for t in git docker curl pg_dump; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || miss="$miss,$t"; done
echo "OD-PF tools missing=${miss#,}"

docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && p=ok || p=fail
sudo -n docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && s=ok || s=fail
echo "OD-PF docker plain=$p sudo=$s mode=sudo-password use=auto"
if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "OD-PF docker become=ok"; else echo "OD-PF docker become=fail"; fi

R={{ d.repo | quote }}
if [ -d "$R/.git" ]; then echo "OD-PF repo exists=1 git=1"; elif [ -d "$R" ]; then echo "OD-PF repo exists=1 git=0"; else echo "OD-PF repo exists=0 git=0"; fi

git update-index -q --refresh
if git diff-index --quiet HEAD --; then echo "OD-PF clean ok=1"; else echo "OD-PF clean ok=0 files=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; fi

B={{ d.branch | quote }}
if git fetch --force --tags origin "refs/heads/$B:refs/remotes/origin/$B" >/dev/null 2>&1; then f=1; else f=0; fi
if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$B"; then v=1; else v=0; fi
echo "OD-PF branch fetched=$f exists=$v"

C={{ d.compose | quote }}
if [ -f "$C" ]; then
  s=$(if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then D=docker; else D='sudo -n docker'; fi && $D compose '-f' deploy/compose.yml config '--services' 2>/dev/null | base64 | tr -d '\n')
  echo "OD-PF compose exists=1 services_b64=$s"
else echo "OD-PF compose exists=0"; fi

a=$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
echo "OD-PF disk avail_kb=${a:-0}"

V={{ od.version | quote }}
if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/$V" >/dev/null; then echo "OD-PF version-tag exists=1"; else echo "OD-PF version-tag exists=0"; fi

T={{ d.tag | quote }}
B={{ d.branch | quote }}
if o=$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/$T" "refs/tags/$T^{}" 2>/dev/null); then ok=1; c=$(echo "$o" | awk 'END {print $1}'); else ok=0; c=""; fi
if [ "$ok" = 0 ]; then echo "OD-PF commits unknown"; else
  if [ -n "$c" ] && git cat-file -e "$c^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then R="$c..origin/$B"; X="$c"; else R="origin/$B"; X=""; fi
  out=$(git log --no-merges --max-count=501 --pretty=tformat:%H%x1f%s%x1f%an%x1f%aI%x1e "$R" 2>/dev/null | base64 | tr -d '\n')
  o=$(git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/remotes/origin/$B^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "OD-PF commits log_b64=$out origin_head=$o"
fi

miss=""
for t in git docker curl; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || miss="$miss,$t"; done
echo "OD-PF tools missing=${miss#,}"
